data_mix.human: the human s0 build (185,480 rows; 119,334 TRAIN), y = z, as v1
data_mix.earlier_selfplay: the ten builds v1 trained on (gen0, gen1, r2-sp0, r2-sp1, r3-sp0, loop-sp6..9, p2v1-c0), with v1's 5,466 labels, unchanged
data_mix.c1: the three r1 builds p2v1-c1-s0..2, passed to train.py --labelled-only: their TRAIN rows are cut to the rows carrying a new deep/exact label (y = 0.5 z + 0.5 v_deep, or v_exact), their VAL rows likewise (none, as only train games are labelled), their TEST rows untouched. So c1 adds only deep-labelled positions (~25k expected), not r1's 61,000 cheap rows
data_mix.human_weight: chosen so the human share of the training weight equals v1's: v1 had 119,334 human of 204,433 train rows = 0.58373. --human-weight = round(0.58373 / (1 - 0.58373) * SP_train_rows / 119,334, 2), where SP_train_rows = the self-play train rows after the labelled-only cut, read from a zero-epoch count. Stated in the report with the resulting shares

training.flags: --arch attn --epochs 12 --threads 3 --lr 1e-3 --wd 1e-4 --dropout 0.1 --seed 1 --boot 2000 --block 2048 --bs 512 --human-weight <as above> --labelled-only <c1 builds> --eval-exclude gen0,gen1,r2-sp0,r2-sp1 (v1's flags otherwise)
training.selection: the epoch with the lowest combined validation loss (human val vs z + self-play val vs y), as v1; c1 contributes no val rows

gates.a_heldout: PASS iff the 95% upper bound (bootstrap over games, 2,000) of (r2 - gen5) log-loss against the OUTCOME is < 0 on BOTH the human test set AND the self-play test set. The self-play test set is r1's (includes c1's test split), so r2 and r1 are read on identical rows. If (a) fails on either half: STOP, report, no arena game.
gates.a_report_only: r2 vs v1 and r2 vs r1 on v1's own test rows, solver/porygon2/v1/compare.js, paired by game
gates.c_sprt: node solver/machamp/sprt.js --release eaa5becc54eb --x solver/porygon2/v1/gen5-p2v1r2.json --y solver/machamp/league/gen5.json --elo0 0 --elo1 20 --alpha 0.05 --beta 0.05 --max-games 2000 --seed 9101 --workers 3 --team-store C:/Users/willj/Projects/Pokemon/ABRA/data/team-pool-frozen-regmc --info honest --out solver/out/p2v2/sprt/r2-vs-gen5.json. Both arms gen5 MAG + DODUO, MILTANK k 4x4, 1 reserved switch row, depth 0, 1,000 ms per decision (equal wall-clock). The same parameters and battle seed as v1's and r1's runs. PASS iff H1. Read once, at the bound or the budget; no interim LLR.
gates.land: only if (a) passes on both halves AND (c) is H1 AND test-porygon2-v1 (+ run_breaks RED on every break) and test-docs-current are green. Otherwise the results, the report and the notes row land; the model switch does not.
